items.text: I’m using the domain-modeling skill to reconcile the research, PRD, prior review, and existing code vocabulary, then capture only stable domain terms in the appropriate `CONTEXT.md`. I’ll surface any contradictions before encoding them.

The referenced task shows that most terminology decisions were already made and written into the working tree. I’m treating those edits as existing user work, validating them against the full documents and looking for unresolved model gaps rather than recreating or overwriting them.

The canonical glossary and PRD are internally consistent. One alignment gap remains in reviewer-facing docs: `README.md` and `DECISIONS.md` still use the deprecated words “expense” and “assessment” for product concepts. Per the project guidance, I’m aligning those references while leaving archived research and verbatim regulatory usage unchanged.

diff.text:
@@ -7,3 +7,3 @@
 
-## Why the assessment is deterministic
+## Why financial decisions are deterministic
 
@@ -15,3 +15,3 @@
 
-Azure OpenAI suggests classifications for unknown expenses and optionally rewrites approved facts into customer-friendly language.
+Azure OpenAI suggests classifications for unknown outgoings and optionally rewrites approved facts into customer-friendly language.
 Known descriptions use deterministic rules, and every new model suggestion requires customer confirmation.

@@ -6,3 +6,3 @@
 Financial results are deterministic and auditable.
-Azure OpenAI is limited to unconfirmed expense-classification suggestions and optional personalized explanations.
+Azure OpenAI is limited to unconfirmed outgoing-classification suggestions and optional personalized explanations.
 
@@ -27,4 +27,4 @@
 3. Review the current monthly position, resilience, and historical change.
-4. Add a known expense and observe deterministic classification.
-5. Add an ambiguous expense and confirm or correct the Azure OpenAI suggestion.
+4. Add a known outgoing and observe deterministic classification.
+5. Add an ambiguous outgoing and confirm or correct the Azure OpenAI suggestion.
 6. Preview and confirm a new immutable snapshot.

items.text:
Domain model is now sharpened and aligned across:

- [CONTEXT.md](/Users/talibilat/Documents/Projects/CustomerFinancialHealthAgent/CONTEXT.md)
- [PRD.md](/Users/talibilat/Documents/Projects/CustomerFinancialHealthAgent/docs/research/PRD.md)
- [coding-agent-ingestion.md](/Users/talibilat/Documents/Projects/CustomerFinancialHealthAgent/docs/research/coding-agent-ingestion.md)
- [README.md](/Users/talibilat/Documents/Projects/CustomerFinancialHealthAgent/README.md)
- [DECISIONS.md](/Users/talibilat/Documents/Projects/CustomerFinancialHealthAgent/DECISIONS.md)

The model now clearly distinguishes editable financial statements, immutable confirmed snapshots, corrections, statement periods, arrears, existing repayment commitments, and hypothetical repayment scenarios. Outgoing terminology is used consistently instead of the overloaded “expense” and “assessment” language.

Archived research retains its original terminology for provenance. No ADR was warranted because these are reversible language refinements, not architectural decisions.

Validation passed:

- Embedded `CONTEXT.md` and PRD exactly match their canonical files.
- Deprecated terms remain only in explicit `_Avoid_`, customer-care examples, regulatory phrases, or archived sources.
- `git diff --check` passes.
- No em dashes were introduced.
- No code tests were needed for documentation-only changes.
